decision: Reject the address-driver fences. Matched coarse congestion worsens and every prior setup margin declines with more typical/slow slew violations. Keep the repaired R0 timing reference and older routing reference.
scope: One twelve-address-driver regional policy and one native placement/CTS/repair continuation. Original SRAM R0 footprints, core RTL, serial ABI and canonical physical sources unchanged. Two matched coarse5 routes complete; no full50 attempt, second candidate or accepted route.

physical_policy.mechanism: New metadata-only OpenDB region/group step after exact accepted ApplyDEFTemplate checkpoint; use region.addGroup/group.addInst. No initial cell positions/status/masters/logical terminals, rows, macros, pins or power shapes change at insertion. GPL/DPL reserves these real fence rectangles exclusively from nongroup cells; this is not a soft guide.
physical_policy.collateral_placement: Twenty-six baseline nongroup cells overlap the two reservations and may be displaced. Report this physical side effect and upstream wire/timing change.

placement_effect.metric_scope: Cell-center L1 distances to actual SRAM pin centers are placement proxies, not routed wirelength or delay. Overlap counts include whole saved bins and are nonadditive across nearby reservations. Shared input/clock/data logic is unfenced; native placement/repair can move the whole design. Fresh STA is the electrical assessment.

policy.policy_change: Only selected twelve-address-driver region/group metadata added before the same GPL/repair continuation; resulting cell movement/master repair can be global.

control.boundary: One native5-iteration-per-segment coarse congestion-allowed diagnostic; not equivalent to full50-iteration benchmark. Native automatic clock-NDR fallback retained; no cell mutation, accepted route or signoff claim. Unchanged inventory covers masters/positions/orientations/logical terminals, not routing-rule state. Saved grid and directional native totals are independent representations.

candidate.boundary: One native5-iteration-per-segment coarse congestion-allowed diagnostic; not equivalent to full50-iteration benchmark. routing.boundary: Identical coarse5 policy, libraries/SDC/capacities/runtime/resources with native automatic NDR fallback. Both completed with unchanged within-arm inventory/netlist. measurement.scope: Fresh native per-corner STA of the selected settled SRAM access candidate ODB, no inherited state metrics/SDF/SPEF. Fixed 20ns clock, 4ns max and 0.2ns min I/O, 0.2ns uncertainty and 10fF output load. Native corner script uses global-route or placement-estimated parasitics based on ODB routes; no extraction, resizing, route mutation, equivalence or signoff. Fast uses -40C logic/I/O and -55C SRAM conditionally.

native_metadata.boundary: Native OpenDB macro orientation, exact footprint, transformed loaded Metal4 supply contacts and unchanged complete supply wire/via/boundary geometry. No DRC, IR drop or current capacity claim.

measurement.boundary: Fresh native whole-grid both-net connectivity and exact candidate R0 geometry/contact/fence readback. No cell/netlist/grid mutation, DRC, IR drop or routed signoff.

power_and_fences.boundary: Connectivity/geometry/fence compliance only. No IR drop, current capacity or routed geometric qualification.

mapped_upload.boundary: Finite zero-delay functional validation and source custody; no universal RTL equivalence or physical signoff.

experiment_acceptance.scope: Congestion improvement cannot override lost setup margins or increased electrical violations. These diagnostic gates do not replace mapped function, accepted routing, signoff or authorize adoption; inherited producer power failure remains separate.

resource_accounting.allowance_scope: Metered host work is charged once, in addition to a conservative 30-second allowance for intake, staging, failed collector attempts, final root checks and any other uninstrumented host work. Host-only reservation is 60s after allocating30s from the previously unallocated165s; physical treatment and all CAD caps remain unchanged. Mapped simulation has its separate declared900s host gate.

supplemental_host_readback.final_analysis_numeric_source: Independent fresh native route cell geometry and power readback; legacy receipt contributes a frozen producer-status reference only.
